ngaap.guidance: 2024 guidance (initiated 25-Jan-2024): Revenue $20.7B - $21.3B; segment operating margin ~15%; non-GAAP EPS $12.40 - $12.80; free cash flow ~$2.2B. By segment: SAS revenue $6,900M - $7,100M, segment operating margin mid-high 11%; IMS $6,400M - $6,600M, low-mid 11%; CS $5,300M - $5,400M, low-mid 24%; AR $2,400M - $2,500M, high 11%. Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$40M (2023: $110M); non-service FAS pension income ~$260M (2023: $310M); net interest expense ~$650M (2023: $544M); effective tax rate on non-GAAP income 13.0% - 13.5% (2023: 13.0%); average diluted shares flat - up slightly (2023: 190.6M); capex ~2% of sales. No reconciliation of forward-looking non-GAAP measures provided. LHX NeXt cost savings target $1 billion (gross run-rate exiting year 3; ~$400M of costs through 2025).
ngaap.notes: Q4-23 release (conventional format) redefines the measures: 'Segment operating income / margin' is now itself the non-GAAP measure = operating income excluding unallocated items (unallocated corporate department expense, FAS/CAS operating adjustment), amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, inventory step-up, merger / acquisition / divestiture-related expenses, divestiture gains/losses, impairment of goodwill and other assets, LHX NeXt implementation costs and gain on sale of property, plant and equipment; by segment it is GAAP segment operating income excluding impairments and the PP&E gain. Non-GAAP EPS = EPS adjusted per share for each of those items, non-operating income adjustments, income taxes on the adjustments and the noncontrolling-interest portion (an itemised per-share bridge is printed for the first time). Pension (FAS/CAS operating adjustment, non-service FAS pension income) is NOT excluded. 'Free cash flow' (the former 'adjusted free cash flow') = operating cash flow less additions to PP&E plus proceeds from sale of PP&E plus cash used for merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses; cash used for LHX NeXt, added back in the Q3-23 letter (45 YTD), is no longer added back (Q3 YTD 1,307 + Q4 747 = 2,054 vs FY 2,009). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income reconciled in Table 7. FY2023 item $ amounts from Table 5 (total 1,496). items_tax_effect (330) is derived from Table 7 (non-GAAP tax expense 353 less GAAP tax expense 23); Table 7 groups: integration and project costs 289 (tax 56), amortization and inventory step-up 809 (tax 191), divestitures, restructuring and impairments 398 (tax 83); non-GAAP income before income taxes 2,716. FY2022 comparatives restated to this presentation: non-GAAP EPS 12.90 = 5.49 + 3.13 + 0.84 - 0.04 + 4.14 + 0.31 + 0.04 - 0.99 - 0.02; 'free cash flow' 2,029. No adjusted EBIT published.
